rows.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
rows.answer: Full‑time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave each year【1】.

rows.question: How many unused leave days can I carry forward to next year?
rows.answer: Employees may carry forward up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next year【1】.

rows.question: By what date must carried-forward leave days be used?
rows.answer: Carried‑forward annual leave days must be used by March 31, after which they expire【1】.

rows.question: How many paid sick days do employees receive each year?
rows.answer: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year [1].

rows.question: After how many consecutive sick days is a medical certificate needed?
rows.answer: A medical certificate is required after 3 consecutive days of sick leave【1】.

rows.question: How many weeks of parental leave does the primary caregiver get?
rows.answer: The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of paid parental leave【1】.

rows.question: How many days of bereavement leave for an immediate family member?
rows.answer: Employees receive 5 days of paid bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member【1】.

rows.question: What are the core working hours?
rows.answer: The core working hours are 10:00 am to 4:00 pm local time, during which all employees must be available. [1]

rows.question: How many days a week can employees work remotely?
rows.answer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, provided they have manager approval【1】.

rows.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
rows.answer: The probation period for new employees is 3 months【2】.

rows.question: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
rows.answer: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the date the expense was incurred【1】.

rows.question: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling for work?
rows.answer: The daily meal allowance for employees travelling on company business is up to $60 per day【1】.

rows.question: What is the maximum hotel reimbursement per night?
rows.answer: The hotel reimbursement limit is up to $180 per night [1].

rows.question: For which expense amounts is a receipt required?
rows.answer: A receipt must be provided for any expense that exceeds $25 [1].

rows.question: How often are performance reviews held and in which months?
rows.answer: Performance reviews are conducted twice a year, specifically in June and in December [1].

rows.question: What is the yearly learning budget per employee?
rows.answer: The learning budget is $1,200 per employee each year【1】.

rows.question: What is the notice period after probation?
rows.answer: After probation, the resignation notice period is 60 days [1].

rows.question: What is the minimum password length?
rows.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long【1】.

rows.question: How often do passwords have to be changed?
rows.answer: Passwords must be changed every 180 days (or immediately if a compromise is suspected)【1】.

rows.question: After how many minutes of inactivity must computers lock?
rows.answer: Computers must lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity【1】.

rows.question: Are USB storage devices allowed by default?
rows.answer: No, USB storage devices are disabled by default and must be approved by the security team to be enabled [1].

rows.question: How quickly must suspected phishing emails be reported?
rows.answer: Suspected phishing emails must be reported to security@northwind.example within 1 hour of discovery【1】.

rows.question: How fast does the security team respond to a P1 incident?
rows.answer: The security team must respond to a P1 (critical) incident within 15 minutes [1].
